stories.title: Nasdaq 100 futures −3% on tariff plan and hotter core PCE
stories.body: S&P 500 futures were −2.05% at 7,069.25, Nasdaq 100 futures −3.13% and Dow futures −1.31% before the open (Yahoo Finance, 8:56 AM ET) after a US tariff proposal and core PCE of 3.3% vs 3.2% expected. Tuesday: S&P 500 7,201.09 (−0.50%), Dow 50,018.70 (+0.85%) (Upstox).
stories.why: A gap this size puts SPY and QQQ's first completed 1-hour candle far from Tuesday's close; today is the week's last full session.

stories.title: Megacaps set to open lower; Alphabet about −4% premarket
stories.body: Alphabet was down about 4% premarket (CNBC data via Chip Dispatch). Tuesday: AAPL $354.07 (+1.43%), MSFT $496.13 (+0.74%), AMZN $252.29 (−1.21%), GOOG $276.58 (−1.06%); no company news for Apple, Microsoft or Amazon this morning.
stories.why: Megacaps cushioned Tuesday's chip selloff; the first completed hourly close shows whether that holds.

stories.title: Chips extend losses premarket: Micron −8%, AMD −6.9%
stories.body: At 8:50 AM ET Micron was −8.0% and AMD −6.9% (Chip Dispatch); around 7:05 AM Intel was −3.8% and Broadcom −3.9% (BigGo Finance). BNP Paribas Exane cut Micron to Neutral, target $775 from $1,700 (BigGo). SK Hynix fell 11.1% in Seoul (Al Jazeera).
stories.why: A third straight wide move keeps chip implied volatility high; the first completed 1-hour candle is cleaner than thin premarket prints.

stories.title: Banks and oil majors rose Tuesday; crude eased overnight
stories.body: Tuesday: CVX $208.73 (+1.24%), XOM $158.23 (+0.85%), BAC $48.56 (+0.87%), JPM $317.10 (+0.14%). Overnight AP had US crude −1.7% at $80.69; the 10-year yield was about 4.85% at 5:24 AM ET vs 4.90% (Upstox).
stories.why: Softer crude and a lower 10-year yield are the inputs behind these names' first completed hourly closes.

stories.title: Nvidia −6% premarket as Trump floats a stake and a Huang pardon
stories.body: Nvidia was −6.2% at $145.80 at 8:50 AM ET (Chip Dispatch) after a $155.38 (−5.86%) close. Trump told the New York Post he had considered a US stake in Nvidia (BigGo Finance) and said a Huang pardon is 'always an option' (Yahoo Finance); House GOP chairmen plan interviews with Huang in early December (BigGo).
stories.why: Political headlines are moving the stock between sessions; completed 1-hour closes filter premarket noise.

stories.title: Gold −2.3%, silver −3.5% after PCE
stories.body: COMEX gold was $3,479.90 (−2.3%) and silver $39.35 (−3.5%) after the PCE data (Upstox, ~9:00 AM ET), which cited a firmer dollar, yields and Fed-hike bets. Tuesday: GLD $325.45 (−2.27%), SLV $36.84 (−5.32%).
stories.why: Futures moved on the data before the ETFs open; the first completed hourly candle shows how GLD and SLV price it.

stories.title: US proposes tariffs of up to 20% on China, the EU and others
stories.body: The administration proposed tariffs of up to 20% on China, the EU and 12 other partners after a probe into excess capacity, likely effective in January at the earliest; the China truce expires Jan. 10 (Yahoo Finance). AP and BigGo put the count at 16 partners.
stories.why: Trade headlines can gap prices between sessions; OXY and USO hourly closes show how oil-linked names absorb them.

stories.title: VIX jumps above 31 before the open
stories.body: The VIX was 31.46 (+19.36%) on Yahoo Finance's quote bar Wednesday morning, after a 26.36 close Tuesday.
stories.why: A VIX above 30 lifts option premiums; this week's short-dated options also span Thursday's closure.

stories.title: Hike odds near 98% after core PCE beat; 10-year yield slips
stories.body: Traders priced about a 98% chance of a 25 bp December hike (CME via Yahoo Finance). The 10-year yield was 4.842% (−6.2 bp) on Yahoo Finance's quote bar, vs a 4.90% Tuesday close (Upstox).
stories.why: Hike pricing frames the tech selloff; yield moves can shift index ETFs within one hourly candle.

stories.title: Asian chips plunge, KOSPI −6.2%; Europe steadier
stories.body: KOSPI −6.16% to 4,697.51, Nikkei −2.78% to 57,011.62, Shanghai −2.03%, Hang Seng −1.1% (Trading Economics); SK Hynix −11.1%, Tokyo Electron −12.5% (Al Jazeera). In Europe's morning, CAC 40 +1.2% and FTSE 100 +0.5%; the DAX slipped (Trading Economics).
stories.why: Asia's chip suppliers now move with US chip names before the open.

stories.title: Core PCE 3.3% beats; Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%; claims 189K
stories.body: October PCE rose 3.8% y/y as forecast; core 3.3% vs 3.2% expected (Yahoo Finance, SSBCrack). Q3 GDP second estimate 4.3% vs 3.4% advance and 3.5% forecast (BEA, XTB). Claims fell to 189,000 vs 200,000 expected (Rallies).
stories.why: The 8:30 AM data shows up in the opening gap, not inside an hourly candle.

stories.title: Nvidia options: 4.6M contracts Tuesday, led by a $150 put expiring today
stories.body: Longbridge counted 4,633,214 NVDA contracts Tuesday, 55% calls; the top contract was the Nov. 25 $150 put (182,925). NVDA was $145.80 premarket (Chip Dispatch).
stories.why: Heavy same-day strike volume near the price can add to swings there; reported activity, not a signal.

stories.title: Ahead: Beige Book today; Thanksgiving, then a 1:00 PM Friday close
stories.body: New home sales 10:00 AM, $44B 7-year auction 11:30 AM (KCEX), Beige Book 2:00 PM ET (Gotrade). Markets close Thursday and reopen Friday for a half day (Yahoo Finance). Broadcom reports Dec. 9 (Broadcom IR).
stories.why: The holiday means fewer completed hourly candles and gap risk around Thursday and Friday's early close.
